title: VIDEO - Visual Integration of Drosophila Enhancer Organization: A tool for integrating and visualizing chromatin accessibility, in vivo transcription factor binding and motif occurrence in tissue-specific differentially expressed genes
authors: Vidya Ajay; Nathaniel Laughner; Patrick Cahan; Deborah J. Andrew
one_liner_zh: 该文介绍了一个整合ATAC-seq、ChIP-seq和基序可视化的果蝇增强子分析工具，虽涉及TF结合位点可视化，但缺乏AI或物理模拟方法，且未深入互作建模，仅作为工具应用，与课题核心方法匹配度低。
abstract: A bstract Dissecting gene regulation today relies on many genomic assays – including transcriptional output from RNA-seq, chromatin accessibility from ATAC-seq, and transcription factor (TF) binding from ChIP-seq. Whereas numerous tools exist for each modality and some integrate data across modalities, few allow researchers to interactively explore and visualize how TF binding motifs intersect with transcriptional activity and chromatin accessibility in a tissue-specific context. Here we introduce VIDEO ( V isual I ntegration of D rosophila E nhancer O rganization), a web-based analysis tool that enables visualization of conserved TF binding motifs within proximal promoters of genes differentially expressed in specific tissues. Starting with gene lists derived from in situ hybridization, microarray, and/or scRNA-seq studies of WT or mutant samples, one can identify the TFs expressed in each tissue and learn if and where the consensus binding motifs for those TFs are found within the proximal enhancers of a custom gene set. This pipeline also allows for coincident visualization of active chromatin, as determined from ATAC-seq data, and for the visualization of DNA binding data from ChIP-seq datasets for specific TFs. To demonstrate its utility, we apply VIDEO to the well-characterized regulatory system of CrebA and the secretory pathway in the Drosophila salivary gland. We also explore a lesser-known system in the embryonic hindgut to show how utilization of this tool can serve to generate hypotheses regarding regulatory interactions.
abstract_zh: 摘要 当今解析基因调控依赖于多种基因组学检测手段——包括来自RNA-seq的转录输出、来自ATAC-seq的染色质可及性，以及来自ChIP-seq的转录因子（TF）结合。尽管针对每种模态存在众多工具，且有些工具整合了跨模态数据，但很少有工具能让研究人员以组织特异性背景交互式探索和可视化TF结合基序如何与转录活性和染色质可及性相交。在此，我们介绍VIDEO（果蝇增强子组织的可视化整合），一种基于网络的分析工具，能够可视化在特定组织中差异表达基因的近端启动子内的保守TF结合基序。从源自原位杂交、微阵列和/或单细胞RNA-seq研究的野生型或突变体样本的基因列表出发，可以识别每种组织中表达的TF，并了解这些TF的共有结合基序是否以及位于自定义基因集的近端增强子内何处。该流程还允许同时可视化活性染色质（由ATAC-seq数据确定），以及特定TF的ChIP-seq数据集中的DNA结合数据。为展示其实用性，我们将VIDEO应用于果蝇唾液腺中CrebA和分泌途径的充分表征的调控系统。我们还探索了胚胎后肠中一个较少为人知的系统，以展示利用该工具如何有助于生成关于调控相互作用的假设。
